entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a GENERIC URGR creature illustration for the category card 'Urgren – the cursed bears' in Aleria's bestiary. Create ONE complete monstrous cursed BEAR, isolated on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, portrait format 2:3 with comfortable empty alpha margin on all sides. The reference image provides only the fine sepia ink drawing, matte watercolor material, heavy bear anatomy and sinister mood. This is a general Urgr specimen, not the specifically named Madrúach creature: do NOT copy its antlers, human face, armor, skulls or trophies. A huge bear on all four massive paws, towering muscular hunched shoulder girdle, broad heavy body, thick powerful forelegs, natural bear hindlegs and a recognizably BEAR head. Its unnatural corruption shows in a cruel, intelligent narrowed amber gaze, a rugged asymmetrical scarred muzzle, slightly overgrown fangs and enormous curved claws. Dark grey-brown unwashed shaggy matted fur, disordered tufts and restrained old scars, no fresh injuries or gore. Low threatening three-quarter pose looking toward viewer, entire head and all four complete paws visible, believable quadruped anatomy. Traditional hand-illustrated dark fantasy bestiary, organic fine sepia ink and graphite contours, matte watercolor washes INSIDE the creature, subdued earthy pigments and visibly drawn fur masses. Preserve opaque painted anatomy and crisp readable silhouette. TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG outside the animal and in open spaces between its legs. Absolutely no parchment, paper rectangle, landscape, floor, ground plane, cast shadow, watercolor splash around the silhouette, mist, halo, background texture, vignette, text, labels, frame or watermark. No giant humanoid, no werewolf, no standing human pose, no antlers, no horns, no clothing, harness, jewelry, shields, skulls or extra animals. This cutout must read clearly as a standalone general cursed bear when placed on an existing parchment UI card.
